
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>Fruit Ninja</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#1f2a1a;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#1f2a1aee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;z-index:3}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(42px,1fr));gap:6px;width:min(90vw,480px);max-height:50vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:10px}
button{background:#f97316;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
button:disabled{background:#3a4a33;color:#8aa07f;cursor:not-allowed}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<div id="h"></div>
<div id="m"></div>

<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const C=canvas.getContext('2d');
const menuEl=document.getElementById('m');
const hudEl=document.getElementById('h');

const N=50;
const K='mg_fruit';
const T='🍉 Fruit Ninja';
const hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches
    ?'Vuốt ngón tay để chém trái cây, tránh bom 💣'
    :'Giữ chuột và rê để chém trái cây, tránh bom 💣';

let W,H,U;
let lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;

let F=[],P=[],tr=[];
let lf=5,sc=0,goal=0,tm=0;

let dn=0;
let lp=null;
let activePointerId=null;

try{
    best=Math.max(1,Math.min(N,Number(localStorage[K])||1));
}catch(e){}

function resetPointer(){
    const id=activePointerId;

    dn=0;
    lp=null;
    activePointerId=null;

    if(id!==null){
        try{
            if(canvas.hasPointerCapture(id)){
                canvas.releasePointerCapture(id);
            }
        }catch(e){}
    }
}

function rs(){
    const oldW=W;
    const oldH=H;

    W=innerWidth;
    H=innerHeight;
    U=Math.min(W,H*.8)*.09;

    if(oldW>0&&oldH>0){
        const sx=W/oldW;
        const sy=H/oldH;

        F.forEach(o=>{
            o.x*=sx;
            o.y*=sy;
            o.vx*=sx;
            o.vy*=sy;
        });

        P.forEach(p=>{
            p.x*=sx;
            p.y*=sy;
            p.vx*=sx;
        });

        tr.forEach(p=>{
            p.x*=sx;
            p.y*=sy;
        });

        if(lp){
            lp.x*=sx;
            lp.y*=sy;
        }
    }

    canvas.width=W;
    canvas.height=H;
}

window.addEventListener('resize',rs);
rs();

function menu(){
    run=0;
    resetPointer();

    menuEl.style.display='flex';
    menuEl.innerHTML=`
        <h2>${T}</h2>
        <p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p>
        <div id="g"></div>
        <p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw;font-size:0.9em">${hint}</p>
    `;

    const grid=document.getElementById('g');

    for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){
        const b=document.createElement('button');

        b.textContent=i;
        b.disabled=i>best;
        b.onclick=()=>go(i);

        grid.append(b);
    }
}

function end(w){
    if(!run)return;

    run=0;
    resetPointer();

    if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){
        best=lv+1;

        try{
            localStorage[K]=best;
        }catch(e){}
    }

    menuEl.style.display='flex';

    menuEl.innerHTML=`
        <h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;">
            <button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button>
            <button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('ba').onclick=()=>{
        go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);
    };

    document.getElementById('bm').onclick=menu;
}

function go(l){
    resetPointer();

    lv=Math.max(1,Math.min(N,l));

    menuEl.style.display='none';

    init();

    run=1;
    lt=performance.now();
}

function loop(t){
    const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);
    lt=t;

    if(run){
        upd(d);

        if(run){
            draw();
        }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const FR=['🍉','🍊','🍎','🍋','🍇','🍓'];

function init(){
    F=[];
    P=[];
    tr=[];

    lf=5;
    sc=0;

    goal=10+lv*2;
    tm=0;

    resetPointer();
}

function spawn(){
    const x=W*(.15+Math.random()*.7);
    const hh=H*(.55+Math.random()*.3);

    const speedMult=1+lv*.01;
    const vy=-Math.sqrt(2*H*1.2*hh)*speedMult;
    const t=-2*vy/(H*1.2);

    const bombChance=lv>1
        ?Math.min(.06+lv*.006,.35)
        :0;

    F.push({
        x,
        y:H+U,
        vy,
        vx:(W/2-x)/t*Math.random()*1.2,
        b:Math.random()<bombChance,
        e:FR[Math.random()*6|0]
    });
}

function dst(p,a,b){
    const dx=b.x-a.x;
    const dy=b.y-a.y;
    const l=dx*dx+dy*dy||1;

    const t=Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(1,((p.x-a.x)*dx+(p.y-a.y)*dy)/l)
    );

    return Math.hypot(
        p.x-a.x-t*dx,
        p.y-a.y-t*dy
    );
}

function cut(a,b){
    F.forEach(o=>{
        if(!o.s&&dst(o,a,b)<U*.7){
            o.s=1;

            if(o.b){
                lf--;

                P.push({
                    x:o.x,
                    y:o.y,
                    vx:0,
                    e:'💥',
                    tl:.5
                });
            }
            else{
                sc++;

                P.push(
                    {
                        x:o.x,
                        y:o.y,
                        vx:-U*3,
                        e:o.e,
                        tl:.4
                    },
                    {
                        x:o.x,
                        y:o.y,
                        vx:U*3,
                        e:o.e,
                        tl:.4
                    }
                );
            }
        }
    });
}

function upd(d){
    tm-=d;

    if(tm<=0){
        tm=Math.max(.8-lv*.01,.25)*(.6+Math.random()*.7);

        spawn();

        if(lv>5&&Math.random()<Math.min(.3+lv*.01,.85)){
            spawn();
        }

        if(lv>20&&Math.random()<.4){
            spawn();
        }
    }

    const gravityMult=1+lv*.005;

    F.forEach(o=>{
        o.vy+=H*1.2*gravityMult*d;

        o.x+=o.vx*d;
        o.y+=o.vy*d;

        if(!o.s&&o.y>H+U&&o.vy>0){
            o.s=1;

            if(!o.b){
                lf--;
            }
        }
    });

    F=F.filter(o=>!o.s);

    P.forEach(p=>{
        p.x+=p.vx*d;
        p.y+=H*.5*d;
        p.tl-=d;
    });

    P=P.filter(p=>p.tl>0);

    if(lf<=0){
        end(0);
        return;
    }

    if(sc>=goal){
        end(1);
        return;
    }
}

function draw(){
    C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    C.font=U+'px serif';
    C.textAlign='center';
    C.textBaseline='middle';

    F.forEach(o=>{
        C.fillText(o.b?'💣':o.e,o.x,o.y);
    });

    P.forEach(p=>{
        C.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.tl*2.5);
        C.fillText(p.e,p.x,p.y);
    });

    C.globalAlpha=1;

    const n=performance.now();

    tr=tr.filter(p=>n-p.t<180);

    if(tr.length>1){
        C.strokeStyle='#fff';
        C.lineWidth=5;
        C.lineCap='round';

        C.beginPath();

        tr.forEach((p,i)=>{
            if(i){
                C.lineTo(p.x,p.y);
            }
            else{
                C.moveTo(p.x,p.y);
            }
        });

        C.stroke();
    }

    hudEl.textContent=`Màn ${lv}/${N} · 🍉 ${sc}/${goal} · ❤️ ${lf}`;
}

function pointerPos(e){
    const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    return {
        x:(e.clientX-rect.left)*(W/rect.width),
        y:(e.clientY-rect.top)*(H/rect.height)
    };
}

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    if(!run||dn||!e.isPrimary)return;

    dn=1;
    activePointerId=e.pointerId;
    lp=pointerPos(e);

    try{
        canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    }catch(err){}
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!dn||!run||e.pointerId!==activePointerId)return;

    const q=pointerPos(e);

    tr.push({
        x:q.x,
        y:q.y,
        t:performance.now()
    });

    if(lp){
        cut(lp,q);
    }

    lp=q;
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{
    if(e.pointerId===activePointerId){
        resetPointer();
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',e=>{
    if(e.pointerId===activePointerId){
        resetPointer();
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',e=>{
    if(e.pointerId===activePointerId){
        resetPointer();
    }
});

window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{
    resetPointer();
});

menu();

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

</body>
</html>
